subject: Log custody split, term cadence, and renewal upsell plan
messages:
From: Sara Hamelin <sara.hamelin@novushealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-11-19T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Log custody split and term cadence for renewal

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As we get closer to the renewal conversation, procurement has asked us to clarify two items that will affect Novus' internal approval:

1) Log custody / hot-window split: we need confirmation of which logs remain in a hot window vs. archived (ingest/retention and access method).
2) Term cadence & pricing impact: our CFO wants to understand tradeoffs between a 12- vs 24-month term and whether the proposed capacity increase changes any retention guarantees.

We also anticipate a SOC 2 re-attestation this cycle and will need a short dry-run of the evidence handoff (names, dates, transfer method). Could you confirm typical timelines and whether you support a temporary burst for a 30-day audit window?

Attached: SOC2-scope-Novus-2026.pdf (scope we expect to cover)

Thanks,
Sara
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager
Novus Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>
To: Sara Hamelin <sara.hamelin@novushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Log custody split and term cadence for renewal

Hi Sara — appreciate the clear ask. Quick answers and a proposed path below.

On log custody / hot-window: our standard config for customers with similar risk profiles is a 90-day hot window (live queryable) + an archival bucket retained for 24 months with role-based access. For Novus' SOC 2 scope we can do either 90d hot / 24m archive or extend the hot window to 365d if the business needs it — there is a capacity and price delta.

Temporary audit burst: yes — we support a time-limited burst for audit windows; typically we allocate additional dedicated throughput for a 14–30 day window and throttle back afterward.

Proposed next steps:
- Kimberly to share evidence staging runbook and an S3-based transfer checklist (technical).
- Ben to circulate commercial options: 12mo vs 24mo term with seat/capacity uplift pricing.
- Schedule a 30–45 minute dry-run with your security team (we recommend a test transfer of a small evidence subset).

If you prefer the 365d hot window we will put together an uplift estimate and an estimated monthly delta.

—Jonas
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Hamelin <sara.hamelin@novushealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-11-19T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Log custody split and term cadence for renewal

Thanks Jonas — that is helpful. A couple clarifications from our end:

- For our auditors we need a 365-day hot window for logs related to authentication, admin activity, and data access events. Other system logs (ingest, infra-level metrics) can be on a 90-day hot / 24-month archive cadence.
- We will almost certainly want the audit burst option for the 30-day window; please specify the capacity uplift (tokens/hour or vGPU-hours) and whether that can be applied without changing the billing cadence.

I attached the SOC2 scope that lists the control families we will test.

Sara

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
To: Sara Hamelin <sara.hamelin@novushealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Log custody split and term cadence for renewal

On Fri, Nov 19, 2026 at 11:45 AM Sara Hamelin <sara.hamelin@novushealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jonas — that is helpful. A couple clarifications from our end:
> - For our auditors we need a 365-day hot window for logs related to authentication, admin activity, and data access events. Other system logs (ingest, infra-level metrics) can be on a 90-day hot / 24-month archive cadence.

Sara — noted. Technical plan (high level):

- Evidence categories: we will tag and separate logs at ingest by category so we can apply different retention policies per tag (auth/admin/data-access = hot365; infra/metrics = hot90/archive24m).
- Access and custody: hot window data remains in customer-isolated buckets with short-term credentials via our IAM proxy; archive buckets are encrypted with customer KMS keys and access is granted through an audit-only role.
- Evidence staging: we propose a two-step runbook: 1) dry-run of a 5GB partition to your audit S3 endpoint; 2) full staging for the audit window. Transfer methods supported: S3 Push, S3 Cross-account copy, or temporary signed transfer via our secure proxy.
- Audit burst sizing: for a 30-day window we recommend a +35% dedicated throughput uplift for the highest ingest days; we can provide a specific vGPU-hours estimate after we see your token/hr profile.
- Timeline: we can prepare the runbook and test credentials within 8 business days; dry-run scheduling subject to your audit team's availability.

I uploaded the evidence-catalog-template.csv to the shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1a2B-novusevidence — that contains the tag mapping and sample CSV we use for SOC 2 intake.

Commercial and contract notes will be handled by Ben — once you confirm the retention split choice we will finalize the technical attachments for the amendment.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Sara Hamelin <sara.hamelin@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Log custody split and term cadence for renewal

Sara / Team — commercial quick note:

- Option A: 12-month renewal, capacity uplift as requested, price delta +8% month-over-month for the extended hot365 category.
- Option B: 24-month renewal, committed capacity +20% (lower unit price), overall uplift ~+15% compared to current ARR but with lower per-token cost and included one-time audit burst credit.

I can generate a redline amendment reflecting the hot365 vs hot90 split plus a clause for a 30-day audit burst credit. If you want the 24mo path I will prepare the exec summary for internal signoff and include a sample contract amendment link.

Pricing link (preview): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234/deal/NV-2026-2410/pricing

—Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Hamelin <sara.hamelin@novushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Log custody split and term cadence for renewal

Thanks all — Novus intends to move forward with Option B (24-month term) pending the amendment text. We accept the proposed retention split: auth/admin/data-access = hot365; infra/metrics = hot90/archive24m.

Please:
- Ben: send the draft amendment and mark the audit-burst credit line item.
- Kimberly / Jonas: schedule a 45-minute dry-run next Thursday (Nov 26) at 10:00 AM PT to test a 5GB evidence transfer.

Once we have the amendment our procurement attorney will route for signature.

Sara
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager
Novus Health
